social_system.objective: Build authority around better judgment and convert relevant readers into Decision Frame users without weakening evidence discipline.

channel_roles.tiktok_reels: demonstrate the method without presenter dependency
channel_roles.reddit: participate usefully where context and evidence matter
channel_roles.github: substantive proof, methods and reusable artefacts only

non_negotiables: Adapt format by channel without changing underlying judgment.
Preserve source, recommendation owner and reversal condition through derivatives when consequential.
No generic AI language, hype or invented precision.
Essential video meaning cannot depend on sound.
No presenters, faces, personal-brand posting, AI avatars or synthetic voice under current brand doctrine.

content_engine.learning_rule: Performance data may improve hooks, examples and formats. It must not rewrite doctrine merely to chase engagement.

launch_system.first_campaign: Decision Frame extracts and methods driving sign-ups to the free Decision Frame.

weekly_source_brief.rule: Use as production input after mapping its legacy evidence labels to canonical GIVEN/DERIVED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN.
